failure_summary.description: Calls misassigned required versus optional fields, selected incorrect schema fields, omitted requested pagination values, or normalized values incorrectly.
Some calls used endpoints that did not match the requested source or result, or failed to cover a distinct requested outcome.
Some responses added unrelated or redundant calls, omitted requested calls, or malformed the list so calls were lost.
Gold calls included unrelated endpoints not requested by the user, so matching them would conflict with the skill's instruction to make every call serve a requested outcome.

patch.reasoning: Most observed issues are already directly addressed by the skill's schema audit, endpoint eligibility, complete-call-set, and JSON validation rules. The one useful clarification is to prevent synonym substitution for user-stated values when enum choices are not documented; the unrelated gold calls in two trajectories should not be encoded as tool-calling guidance.

edits.target: - Preserve requested search text, identifiers, and constraints; normalize only as the endpoint requires, without dropping meaningful words or substituting one value or geographic level for another. Map explicit filters, counts, pages, sorting, locale, category, and location to the corresponding schema fields, using accepted representations for enums and locales.
edits.content: - If a schema declares an enum but does not list its accepted values, do not replace a user-stated label with a synonym or guessed canonical spelling; retain the literal term when its meaning is clear, and do not guess when support is unclear. Preserve the spelling and case of named source values unless the endpoint documents normalization.
